title: SciArena: An Open Evaluation Platform for Foundation Models in Scientific Literature Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Augmenting the Bradley-Terry (BT) model with style feature vectors to quantify the influence of response formatting on human preference votes.
Calculating the Bradley-Terry coefficient for response length to analyze whether human evaluators have a systematic preference for longer model outputs.
Using the Bradley-Terry model to estimate the influence of citation count and the correctness of citation-to-claim attribution (supporting vs. irrelevant/contradicting) on user preferences.
